# R2.6 — control-plane legs: durable steer, staged interpreters

Ticket `docs/tickets/112_R2.6__control-steer-interpreters.md` (seq 112);
stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.5` (#111); ADR-0337.
Offline-only: every cell is deterministic — `fixture`-verified at the
in-process seam, `real-local-process` at the `hh-helper`/env seams;
no live/staging environment is touched or claimed.

## The seam (ADR-0337 D1–D2; DF-S2.11-1; OQ-316)

`queue_next_turn` steering now rides the durable wakeup spine — one
cue channel, not two:

```
steer{mode: next_turn}
  → context.artefact.delivered        (the payload, durable first)
  → control.wakeup.subscribed          (lazy, manual{principal},
                                        delivery_mode = steer)
  → control.wakeup.occurred            (key: steer:<payload_ref>)
  → deliver_wakeup → fired             (deliver_after still withheld
                                        until committed effects settle)
  → Cue::Woken{steer, payload_ref}
  → decide → propose{steer_ref}
```

`SessionState::pending_steer` is deleted — session memory was the
cue's only home and a restart destroyed the steering intent behind the
already-durable artefact. The OQ-316 admission arm admits `steer` on
`manual{principal}` triggers only; every other trigger/delivery-mode
combination answers a typed `WakeupPolicyUnsupported`;
`deliver_due_wakeups` excludes `steer` — the driver drain owns it, a
surface poll never consumes a control cue. The restart cell proves
`occurred` (pre-restart) → `fired` (post lease-expiry takeover)
carrying the staged `payload_ref` across a real store reopen.

## Interpreters (DF-S1.20-1 members; BL-14)

- `steering_for` reads the registered variant's declared
  `capability_declaration`; `hh/react-steerable-queue` is seeded as the
  `queue_next_turn` variant. `strategy_for`/`variant_for` return
  `Option` — unknown refs are typed refusals at `open`, replay
  (`unknown_control_variant`), and plugin `bind` (`NotInstalled`).
  Fallback-to-`react/minimal` is dead on both sides of the process
  line (D3).
- `ReactSteerable` interprets `Woken{steer}` → `propose{steer_ref}` and
  `Woken{follow_up}` → `propose{follow_up_ref}` under a declared
  steering mode; `PlanExecute` answers the stop protocol and parks
  unsequenced cues; `StagedVariant` (`hh/workflow`, `hh/program`) parks
  every cue on `human_input` but stays cancellable (D4).
- `hh-control/src/wire.rs` — the canonical codec for every document the
  ABI edge moves (context, events, cues, decisions, reports, typed
  errors, state checkpoints). `ControlStrategy: Send` — the OOP host
  moves bound variants onto the protocol thread (D5).

## OOP conformance + env kill

`hh-plugin-fixture --mode control` serves the six interpreter ops over
`plugin_abi/1` `invoke` (canonical docs, caller-carried state, typed
refusals). `hh-varhost/tests/control_strategy.rs` 4/4 drives three
variants through the real `hh-helper` boundary — steer interpretation,
the declaration boundary (minimal never mints `steer_ref`), the stop
protocol, determinism, checkpoint/restore, typed refusals. The env
kill cell (`hh-env/tests/r2_6.rs` 2/2) launches a real `/bin/sleep`,
expires the deadline, verifies the pid is reaped, and settles
`unknown{executor_error}` with the durable `action.effect.unknown`
row.

## Latent defects the cells proved out

- **`resume_from` alloc watermark** — the resumed driver re-minted
  `d-1` over a committed `control.decision` row (`DuplicateEventId`);
  in-process takeovers masked it by carrying the live driver. Now
  seeds `next_id`/`decision_events`/`last_decision_ref` from the
  durable prefix (D7).
- **`drain_child` deadline starvation** — a blocking pipe read meant a
  silent child starved the deadline check; the env-owned kill was dead
  code. The drain now pumps reader threads through a bounded
  `recv_timeout` poll; the kill SIGKILLs and reaps (D6).
